answer: Standing grows like an orchard from past work, and every epoch a gale flies through it: the network randomly re-selects old contributions and re-executes them from scratch. Work that reproduces keeps its fruit; fabricated or quietly rotted work drops off and takes its standing with it. The scouts are ravens - independent verifiers drawn fresh each epoch, re-running proofs they had no hand in making. Honest agents lose nothing; their fruit grows back identical each time it is picked. A sybil farm grows paper fruit - the first gale strips it bare, and no season is safe to fabricate in.
